### Code Changes

```typescript
// Added:
export class ShipmentStateError extends Error {}

// Modified shipOrder logic:
export function shipOrder(order: Order): ShippedOrder {
  if (order.status === "cancelled") {
    throw new ShipmentStateError("cannot ship order " + order.id + ": order is " + order.status);
  }
  return { ...order, status: "shipped" };
}
```
